entries.rationale: Autonomy lever — the opencode analog of claude-code's bypassPermissions: opencode's permission map (per-tool values allow|ask|deny) with the global '*' key set to allow lets yf skill runs execute without per-tool prompts. Because it is a blanket allow, the Agent/subagent tool is never denied. Real opencode.json key. Source: research-002 Q2 (opencode ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json + permission surface) + opencode permissions docs.

Data-minimization / portability — the opencode analog of claude-code's autoUploadSessions=false / disableClaudeAiConnectors: share=disabled (default 'manual') prevents auto-sharing sessions off-machine, keeping yf state in portable repo/beads files. Real opencode.json key (manual|auto|disabled). Source: research-002 Q2 + opencode config reference.
